plan.notes: Source: Agnes Scott College 2025-2026 Undergraduate Academic Catalog (official PDF), Mathematics-Economics major requirements: ECO-104, 105, 206, 207, 338; MAT-118, 119, 206, 220, 309; ECO-400; two 300-level electives (one economics, one mathematics). This plan uses ECO-351 (economics) and MAT-328 (mathematics). ECO-215 (Statistics for Business and Economics) is included as the statistics course the catalog names among the ECO-338 prerequisites. Course titles and prerequisites hand-transcribed 2026-09-30; semester sequence from catalog prerequisites (advisor should confirm). Gen ed = SUMMIT 34 cr + 12 cr language + electives to 128.
